description: This file defines the 'CredentialsManagementService' interface, which declares methods for managing device credentials in a system. It includes methods to set (create/update) and get credentials associated with a device, following a specific API. The interface references external components such as 'OperationResult', 'CommonCredential', and uses Vert.x's asynchronous handling mechanisms.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates the credentials for a device, given tenant ID, device ID, optional resource version, list of credentials, and tracing span. Invokes the result handler with the operation outcome, indicating success (204), bad request (400), or not found (404).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves all credentials associated with a device for a given tenant, using the provided tracing span. Calls the result handler with the result, which is either a list of credentials (200) or a not found response (404).
